newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-FTSE to aim for 4,960 pausing at 4,930.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-FTSE to aim for 4,960 pausing at 4,930.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index may reach for 4,960 on Thursday after resting near 4,930, technical analysts said.

Buying intensity on Wednesday had taken the index back above its 10 day moving average and though there may be some fumbling around the 4,930 area owing to profit-taking and stock rotation this will not detract from the upward force which is currently dominating the market, they added.
Stock rotation involves investors switching out of shares which are slowing down to those offering greater upward potential. By 0725 GMT the FTSE was indicated up 4.5 at 4,931.8.

Market turnover statistics confirm what the charts are saying -- that UK shares are in a bull trend. On Wednesday, total market turnover was 850 million shares traded compared with 732 million on Monday and this was as the FTSE gained 75 points in those three days.

Upward forces on Wall Street and the main bourses in Europe should help drive the FTSE higher over the near-term, analysts said, noting that stock markets in the U.S., France and Germany closed at record highs on Wednesday.
